rationale: The single reply correctly tells the customer the bulb is DIY-replaceable once the oven is 'completely cool and switched off at the mains' and specifies a '25W heat-resistant appliance bulb with an SES (small Edison screw) cap ... rated for temperatures up to 300°C', which matches the hidden truth (E14 25W 300C) for the known model, hedged appropriately with 'typically' and a pointer to Neff parts. It uses only what the customer said and invents nothing. It falls short of excellent by not advising the customer to remove the lens cover and read the old bulb's markings to confirm, and by not mentioning that if a new bulb still fails the lamp holder/wiring would need an engineer.
